Specifies ETP hydraulics can only take an occasional overloading of 20% of design flow rate.

Lists mandatory spares for Waste Service water transfer pump motor.

output.why: The WSWS transfer pumps are explicitly specified as 3 x 50% (2W+1S) at 125 m3/hr each to match the 250 m3/hr design capacity of the single working downstream Lamella Clarifier/Tube Settler (1W+1S). Running all three pumps together without a standby violates the mandatory 2W+1S redundancy requirement and produces 375 m3/hr (150% of design flow), which exceeds the ETP hydraulic overloading limit of 20% (300 m3/hr).
